title: The Characteristic Function of the Cube of a Gaussian Random Variable
journal_ref: Journal of Stochastic Analysis: Vol. 6: No. 2, Article 4 (2025). Available at: https://repository.lsu.edu/josa/vol6/iss2/4
abstract: Using the spectral resolution of the multiplication operator on the Schwartz class of $L^2(\mathbb{R},\mathbb{C})$, we compute the characteristic function of the cube of a Gaussian random variable.
